About the Role: We are seeking a highly skilled Mainframe Automation Manager to lead a critical, large-scale automation migration project. You will be joining the initiative at a pivotal moment: the migration is currently 50% complete, with the remaining 50% left to execute. This project strictly follows an IBM migration approach, transitioning legacy systems to modern IBM tooling.
